newsitem.title: USA: Tipperary chairman Anthony Kramer resigns.
newsitem.headline: Tipperary chairman Anthony Kramer resigns.

text.p: Tipperary Corp, an independent oil and gas company, said Tuesday that Anthony Kramer, 56, resigned as chairman of the board due to personal and business demands.
His brother Douglas Kramer, chairman and director of Draper and Kramer Inc, a real estate company headquartered in Chicago, was appointed to the vacant seat.
Kramer also is a director of Slough Estates Plc, a London-based real estate company and major shareholder in SDK Inc, which owns 37.5 percent of Tipperary's common stock.
David Bradshaw, a board member since 1990, was elected Tipperary's interim chairman, the company said.
